open_points.subject: OwnerSession request activity
open_points.text: changed by the owner's requests (State 2 A13, A16; owner, 2026-10-31): the instant of its last request
open_points.question: Which owner-interface requests change the last-request instant: every authenticated request, only product actions, only the cited but unavailable A13/A16 actions, and do refused requests count?
options: Every authenticated owner-interface request, including reads and refusals
Only accepted product actions
Only the future State 2 actions A13 and A16
open_points.default_guess: Every authenticated request made through the session, whether accepted or refused.

open_points.subject: OwnerSession recorded times
open_points.text: Every other model carries only the written-once instants its own facts name ... changed by the owner's requests ... the instant of its last request
open_points.question: Is OwnerSession an exception to the global rule that models other than Project and Customer carry only written-once instants, or must the global rule or the mutable last-request fact be changed?
options: OwnerSession is an explicit exception and carries a mutable instant
The global rule is changed to allow model-specific mutable instants
OwnerSession does not carry a mutable last-request instant
open_points.default_guess: Treat OwnerSession as an explicit exception.

open_points.subject: Pending confirmation creation
open_points.text: at most one pending confirmation ... made when a confirmation step is shown
open_points.question: Exactly which product actions may create a pending confirmation? State 0 names archiving a project, erasing an archived project, importing, and erasing old audit entries, while the new fact also mentions an access version, which suggests an access action not declared as requiring confirmation.
options: Only the four actions State 0 explicitly marks as confirming
Those four actions plus one or more session-access actions
Any owner action State 2 chooses to protect with confirmation
open_points.default_guess: Only the four actions explicitly marked as confirming in State 0.

open_points.subject: Pending confirmation value and confirmation id
open_points.text: at most one pending confirmation — its one-time value ... made when a confirmation step is shown ... The confirmation id of an action the owner confirms in it is minted per confirmation, not per session
open_points.question: Is the pending confirmation's one-time value the confirmation id written to the audit entry and migration closure, or are these two different Registry-minted values, and at which event is the confirmation id minted?
options: They are the same value, minted when the confirmation step is shown
They are different values; the one-time value is minted when shown and the confirmation id when accepted
They are different values, both minted when the confirmation step is shown
open_points.default_guess: Use two values: a one-time pending value minted when shown and a confirmation id minted when the confirmed action is accepted.

open_points.subject: Pending confirmation lifecycle
open_points.question: What event counts as use and clears the pending confirmation: any submission of its one-time value, only a successfully authenticated and matching submission, or only acceptance of the confirmed product action?
options: Any submission attempt clears it
A valid matching confirmation attempt clears it even if the product action is refused
Only an accepted confirmed action clears it
open_points.default_guess: A valid matching confirmation attempt clears it, even if the bound action is then refused.

open_points.subject: Uploaded import file creation
open_points.text: at most one uploaded import file, replaced by the next upload and dropped when the import is accepted
open_points.question: Which product action places or replaces the uploaded file in OwnerSession: a distinct upload action, the first step of the existing import action, or some action outside Registry?
options: A distinct owner-interface upload action creates or replaces it
The import action itself uploads and stores it before confirmation
An external component holds the file and OwnerSession stores only a reference
open_points.default_guess: A distinct owner-interface upload step creates or replaces the session-held file before the confirmed import action.

open_points.subject: Pending import confirmation inputs
open_points.text: every agent session fact ... the owner session, but for its uploaded import file [is business_confidential] ... pending confirmation — ... the inputs it is bound to
open_points.question: When an import confirmation is bound to display names, customer names, tax ids, addresses or other personal inputs, are those values copied into the pending confirmation despite the table classifying every OwnerSession fact except the file as business_confidential, or does the confirmation bind them without storing those values?
options: Pending confirmation inputs retain each underlying fact's disclosure class
Pending confirmation stores only a non-personal reference or digest of personal inputs
All bound inputs are classified business_confidential despite containing personal values
open_points.default_guess: Store only a non-personal reference or digest in the pending confirmation; keep the personal values solely in the uploaded file.

open_points.subject: Registry storage boundary
open_points.text: Registry stores only identity — projects, their objects and rooms, customers with their contact and fiscal data — the project access of each agent session and its pending request, artifact pointers, and its own audit log ... at most one uploaded import file
open_points.question: Is a temporarily stored import file an intended exception to State 0's exhaustive statement of what Registry stores, or must the file remain outside Registry with OwnerSession carrying only a reference?
options: State 0's storage boundary gains a temporary owner-session import-file exception
OwnerSession stores only a reference to a file held outside Registry
The word stores in State 0 means durable domain storage and intentionally excludes temporary session state
open_points.default_guess: Interpret State 0 as describing durable domain storage and allow the import file only as temporary OwnerSession state.
